outcome: Effective diagnosis and care for pregnant women with GDM
Glycemic control (FPG ~ 5.0 mmol/dl, 2 h PPPG ~ 6.7 mmol/dl)
Newborn birth weight appropriate for gestational age (2.5-3.5 kg)
cohort: The study focuses on pregnant women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM).
finding: The economical and evidence-based "single test procedure" of DIPSI is recommended for GDM screening and management during the COVID-19 pandemic, alongside specific glycemic targets and newborn birth weight goals to prevent offspring developing diabetes.
gest_age: Newborns birth weight appropriate for gestational age; testing recommended at 24-28 weeks of gestation.
